children: Vancouver, British Columbia--(Newsfile Corp. - November 19, 2026) - Copper-gold explorer and hybrid project generator
Kincora Copper Limited
Kincora
or
the Company

) is pleased to announce the results of voting at its Annual General and Special Meeting ("AGM" or the "Meeting") on November 19th, 2026 at 4pm PST held by hybrid meeting with webcast from Vancouver, Canada.

All matters submitted to shareholders for approval as set out in the Company's Notice of Meeting and Information Circular, dated October 9th, 2026, were approved by the requisite majority of votes cast at the Meeting with 21.25% of shareholder proxies returned and very strong support for all matters of business.
Details of the resolutions are provided below. A copy of the presentation discussed at the Meeting will be made available on the Kincora website:
Chairman Cameron McRae commented:
"At last year's AGM, we highlighted the importance of laying the foundations for Kincora's next phase of growth, with a share consolidation and strategic placement aligning key shareholders.
It is pleasing to reflect on how we have started to build on these and form a significant hybrid prospect generator providing unique portfolio exposure to large scale copper-gold discovery.

We are achieving a step change in scale with the drill bit, size of the project portfolio, management fee income and cash position. Today, Kincora is a more focused and better-capitalized company, with more metres going into the ground at more targets.
We are still in the early stage of execution with a very exciting 2027 ahead of us.
We thank our shareholders for their continued support and look forward to building on the progress achieved as we enter the next phase of Kincora's growth."

AGM details
Audited Annual Report
Shareholders received and considered the Financial Statements for the financial year ended December 31, 2025 and the report of the auditor thereon.
Number of Directors
Shareholders approved retaining the number of directors at five (5).
Election of Directors

Shareholders voted in favour of Kincora's management's nominees to the board of directors: Jonathan (Sam) Spring (99.69% For), John Holliday (99.71% For), Luke Murray (99.67% For), Cameron McRae (99.67% For) and James Durrant (99.69% For).
Auditor Appointed

Manning Elliot LLP was appointed Auditor of the Company to hold office until the next AGM or until its successor is duly appointed, and the directors were authorized to fix the Auditor's remuneration.
Approval of Issue of Placement Shares
Shareholders passed an ordinary resolution to ratify the issuance prior non-brokered private placement CDI's as described in the Information Circular.
Approval of Issuance Placement Options
Shareholders passed an ordinary resolution to ratify the issuance of non-brokered private placement options relating to prior placement CDI's as described in the Information Circular.
Approval of Issuance Placement Broker Options
Shareholders passed an ordinary resolution to ratify the issuance of non-brokered private placement broker options relating to prior placement CDI's as described in the Information Circular.
Share Capacity

Shareholders passed a special resolution re-approving the capacity to issuance up to an additional 10% capital over a 12-month period pursuant to ASX Listing Rule 7.1A as described in the Information Circular.
Equity Incentive Plan (EIP)
Shareholders passed an ordinary resolution re-approving of amending the existing EIP as amended as described in the Information Circular.
Settlement of Debt
Disinterested shareholders passed an ordinary resolution for the settlement of debts as described in the Information Circular.
ABOUT KINCORA
Kincora Copper Limited
is an emerging Australia-focused gold-copper explorer with a hybrid project generator strategy.

The Company is successfully proving up the prospectivity of its extensive project portfolio, which includes multiple district-scale landholdings and scalable drill ready targets. These assets are in Australia's Lachlan Fold Belt, one of the globe's leading porphyry belts, and the historical Condobolin mining field within the Cobar basin in NSW.

The Company has already unlocked over A$100 million of potential partner funding for multiple earlier stage and/or non-core porphyry projects. These initial deals have supported approximately 25,000 metres of drilling and over A$12m of partner funded exploration since late 2024, with management fees and exploration ramping up.

With a strong cash position of approximately A$13 million, and a further US$3.5-million due before year end (~A$5-million), the Company is now increasing sole funded exploration activities and increasing the scale of its project portfolio.
Various independent reviews have recently taken place supporting a formal process for the next leg of asset level partnerships for the remaining large scale porphyry projects.

During the Australian summer, Kincora plans to invest up to A$3 million in sole-funded, shallow air-core drilling advancing geological concepts and adding scale across four projects and 17 targets. Further to this, preparations are in place to undertake the first drilling in over twenty years at the outcropping mineralised Boree Creek project, which Kincora has a low-cost option over.

The programs are also expected to complement and enhance the value equation of asset-level partner discussions that are ongoing for the remaining 100% owned flagship and advanced exploration stage porphyry projects that are hosted in brownfield environments to existing world-class mines.

By having a significant portfolio of partner funded large porphyry projects and focused capital efficient programs at sole funded projects, the Company is seeking to position Kincora as a leading institutional grade explorer in the public Australian and Canadian markets, and the leading project generator on the ASX.
